curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: match the letters S, L, I and P to their corresponding sounds for reading preparedness

mission.title: S L I P Sound Hop

interactions.prompt: Tap the letter that makes the first sound in sun.
interactions.feedback: Yes! Sun starts with the sound of S.

interactions.prompt: Which word begins with the sound of L?
Match each capital letter to its sound word.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a letter, then its word.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: A picture shows ink. Which letter belongs beside it?
interactions.retryHint: Say the first sound in ink.

interactions.prompt: Pack the market words into their sound baskets.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its letter basket.
interactions.feedback: You used letter sounds to get ready to read!
interactions.retryHint: Listen only to the beginning of each word.

interactions.prompt: Which sequence correctly matches S, L, I, P?
interactions.retryHint: Check one letter and word at a time.
